fix(spl): `$obj->$name()` on a builtin class had no body to reach

MEASURED: a loop over method NAMES died where php answers every one.

    $i = new SplFileInfo("f.txt");
    foreach (["getFilename", "getSize"] as $call) { $i->$call(); }

    php    : f.txt, 4
    elephc : Fatal error: callable array did not resolve to an invokable target

The same loop worked as soon as each name had ALSO been called statically somewhere
in the program. That is what said the dispatch ladder is bounded not by the names a
